title: C&F Financial Corporation Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: TOANO, Va., Aug. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of CF Financial Corporation (NASDAQ:CFFI) (the Corporation) has declared a regular cash dividend of 48 cents per share, which is payable October 1, 2026 to shareholders of record on September 15, 2026. The Board of Directors of the Corporation continually reviews the amount of cash dividends per share and the resulting dividend payout ratio in light of changes in economic conditions, current and future capital requirements, and expected future earnings. About CF CF Bank operates 32 banking offices and five commercial loan offices located throughout Virginia and offers full wealth management services through its subsidiary CF Wealth Management, Inc. CF Mortgage Corporation and its subsidiary CF Select LLC provide mortgage loan origination services through offices located in Virginia and the surrounding states. CF Finance Company provides automobile loans through indirect lending
